Tests batch URI extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const result = await extractBatch([{ config: { outputFormat: "markdown" }, kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, uri: "https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf" } as ExtractInput]);
  for (const item of result.results ?? []) {
    console.log(item.content);
  }
}

void main();
```
